statements.statement: Board member reporting on the March 4 School Committee meeting: updated projected deficit was approximately 1.9 million, down from 2.4 million.
District still faced roughly 900,000 shortfall for level services.
Free cash certified; final certification number stated.
Warrant article to appropriate free cash to the OPEB Trust Fund, the same amount as before (10%).
Salary administration plan adjustments for FY2027 is a 3% COLA; voted to include and recommend approval.
FY2027 omnibus budget article (base budget) voted to include on the warrant; recommendation held off.
Prop 2.5 override article is a placeholder; all five members committed to putting some version of an override on the ballot; not yet included.
Compensated absences reserve fund appropriation of $10,000, voted to include and recommend.
Cost to buy out 100% of vacation time for all four bargaining units plus SIP; buying only time over three weeks is 56,000; sufficient free cash believed available.
FY2026 snow and ice deficit running around half a million dollars; closeout article to include it, from unexpended funds or free cash.
Appropriation to the 300th anniversary committee, expiring June 30, 2029; voted to include and recommend.
Article to rescind two votes and reauthorize $325,000 from a prior capital plan used to fund the FY26 capital plan and also the TCP roof; voted to include and recommend.
Annual operating costs of the TC Passios building stated as $120,000 a year, not including maintenance.
